body:
Problem: #119. Does not close it; the issue closes once the fix is shown to hold.

## Plan

#119's 2026-10-05 08:39Z comment found #137 and #136 racing for #61: the issue carried `good first issue` beside `ready-for-agent`, so the label invited an outside contributor to build what the board's worker was already building. It proposed two fixes: skip an issue that a pull request already references (done in #147), and remove `good first issue` when the job is made. This is the second.

- `finishAutoJob` in `lib/coordinator.mjs` removes the `good first issue` label from the source issue when the job is made, and only that label. A removal GitHub refuses is logged, and the job still stands and the issue is still answered; `finishAutoJob` runs again each sweep against a fresh read of the issue's labels, so the next sweep tries again.
- `lib/github.mjs`: `repoRemoveLabel`.

Not covered: the 403 the coordinator got commenting on legion-social #18 (an access setting, since fixed for near-agencies).

Files: `lib/coordinator.mjs`, `lib/github.mjs`, `test/auto-jobs.test.mjs`.

## Verification

- `npm run check` passes; `npm test`: 616 pass, 0 fail.
- New tests: the job's making removes `good first issue` and leaves `ready-for-agent` and `bug`; an issue without the label draws no removal; a refused removal leaves the job standing and answered, creates no second job, and the next sweep removes the label.
- Not checked: a live run against GitHub.
title: fix: an auto job takes good first issue off its source issue
